remarks: Spacious, light filled and well maintained 2 family home in the heart of New Canaan. First time on the market for sale, this home has been in the same family for over 50 years. Steps from restaurants, shopping and library! Here is your opportunity to purchase an income producing 2 family home. First Floor unit has 2 bedrooms, large eat in kitchen and access to covered front porch, finished basement with laundry area and storage. Second Floor unit features, open deck, 1 bedroom plus a study/den (could be used as 2nd bedroom), tall ceilings, laundry room area and eat in kitchen and oozes charm. Rent both units out or live in one and rent out 2nd unit. Also possibility of converting back to Single family residence as the staircase is still intact. Property is being sold AS IS.
